requirements.expectation: Fresh per-Run Provider and deterministic Judge sandbox replaces shared /control/reset; no existing endpoint or service state is reset.
Local Human, Provider, Provider Bot, original driver-to-worker trust and public visibility using the Bot runtime credential are created and bound before the first Run.
Validated fixed-editorial definition executes approved Loop: two iterations preserve prior output, reject stale response_ref, route approved to polish, and finish the Run.
One-shot Session Run with exhausted fixed Loop preserves previous output, records revise/exhausted route, and continues through rewrite rather than fabricating approval.
After Loop completion the explicit Session remains running and its editorial output is published to chat exactly once, distinct from the six state-machine node outputs.
Graph and message history agree across completed and skipped nodes, exact execution metadata, six one-output events, immutable reload, and a single final output.
Only the two created Groups and the new Provider Bot are deleted through original business APIs; retained histories, associations and non-target state remain explicit.

Shared /control/provider/clear and broad reset become per-Run immutable Provider receipts plus explicit deterministic Judge results; each Run receives its approved or exhausted fixture without cross-Run leakage.
